summary: Issue categories that partition the intakes of one harness technician audit. REPAIR-001 is the normative owner; this registry is the one place that names the categories, their filename slugs, their scope, and their next-action contract.

categories.scope: Work a powerful model executes outside harness bounds under close operator supervision, such as a governance or policy bug fix.
Speed and memory improvements, removal of duplicate agent work or tool calls, bottleneck relief, and concurrency or race-condition repair.
Conflicting governance resolution, and agent behavior that undoes or contradicts another agent action or governance.
Agents that apply governance inconsistently or ignore it, and gaming or cheating behavior.
Harness mechanics that are technically correct but repeatedly cause internal or operator friction.
Command invocation failures, uncovered edge cases, build breakage, and embedded install defects.
Governance or mechanics that violate broadly accepted agentic best practice.
